raw.details:
Welcome To CodeBuild 2.0!

Where Ideas Find Builders.

Ideas are only the beginning. The real challenge is turning them into something that works.

CodeBuild 2.0, organised by CoBuild, is a 24-hour offline hackathon bringing together ambitious student builders to solve problems, collaborate with fellow innovators, and turn ideas into practical technology solutions.

Join us for two days of innovation, teamwork, and building. Compete with talented students, showcase your technical skills, and stand a chance to win from a total prize pool worth ₹6,00,000, featuring cash prizes, swags, goodies, and vouchers.

Every winning team will receive a dedicated trophy, along with a special CoBuild Box packed with exciting items.

Event Details:

  • Dates: 15–16 January 2027
  • Venue: Delhi Technological University (DTU), Delhi
  • Format: 24-hour offline hackathon
  • Team Size: 2–4 members
  • Organised By: CoBuild
  • Official WhatsApp Group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/KVSHaeGtkrKGiasazFYbdC?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4
  • Official WhatsApp Community: Every team member must join the community for updates: https://chat.whatsapp.com/EelRt8CGKeU09pI7OBNC9F

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Open to student innovators and aspiring developers who meet the event's registration requirements.
  • Participants must register in teams of 2–4 members.
  • Teams must comply with the official registration and submission guidelines.
  • All team members should ensure that their registration details are accurate.

Detailed eligibility conditions and participation guidelines will be communicated through the official event page.

Rounds And Stages:

Round 1 — PPT Submission

Shortlisted teams will submit a presentation outlining their proposed solution.

  • Explain the problem your team intends to solve.
  • Present your idea, proposed approach, and its potential impact.
  • Communicate your solution clearly through a structured presentation.
  • Theme: Open Innovation.

The top 200 teams will qualify for the offline Grand Finale.

Round 2 — Offline Grand Finale

The selected teams will come together at DTU, Delhi, for the 24-hour offline hackathon.

  • Turn your idea into a working project.
  • Collaborate with your teammates to develop and improve your solution.
  • Demonstrate your project's core functionality and practical value.
  • Present your final work according to the event's submission and judging guidelines.

The Grand Finale will provide teams with an opportunity to showcase their skills, creativity, and execution under a time-bound building challenge.

Rewards And Prizes:

A Total Prize Pool Worth ₹6,00,000

CodeBuild 2.0 celebrates creativity, technical excellence, and the effort it takes to build something meaningful.

The total prize pool includes a combination of:

  • Cash Prizes
  • Swags And Goodies
  • Vouchers And Rewards

What Winning Teams Receive:

Dedicated Team Trophy:

Every winning team will receive a dedicated trophy to recognise its achievement.

Special CoBuild Box:

An exclusive box featuring a collection of exciting items for winning teams.

Additional Rewards:

Eligible teams can also win from the announced cash prizes, goodies, swags, and vouchers, according to the final prize distribution.

The detailed prize breakdown, award categories, and eligibility for individual rewards will be announced through the official event communication.

Why Participate?

  • Build Under Pressure: Experience the challenge of developing a solution within a 24-hour hackathon.
  • Showcase Your Skills: Present your ideas and technical capabilities to the event's evaluators.
  • Collaborate And Learn: Work closely with your teammates and learn through practical execution.
  • Earn Recognition: Compete for trophies, rewards, and a share of the prize pool.
  • Become A Builder: Take your idea beyond a presentation and work towards a functional solution.

Your Idea. Your Team. Your Build.

Whether you're passionate about software development, creative problem-solving, or bringing new ideas to life, CodeBuild 2.0 is an opportunity to challenge yourself and build something meaningful.
